'''Corneal lenses''' were devices that could be placed over a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid's]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and give them a different appearance. Gunslinger [[Amaiza Foxtrain/Legends|Amaiza Foxtrain]] used corneal lenses occasionally to give herself a more catlike appearance.
